package.title: Tempo.Blazor.EmailTemplates
package.description: Drag-and-drop email template editor component (TmEmailTemplateEditor) for Tempo.Blazor. Visual MJML editor with full MJML 4 parity, bidirectional MJML import/export, Scriban variable templating and live preview. Built entirely on Tempo.Blazor components.

gettingStarted.title: Tempo.Blazor.EmailTemplates
gettingStarted.overview: Drag-and-drop email template editor component (TmEmailTemplateEditor) for Tempo.Blazor. Visual MJML editor with full MJML 4 parity, bidirectional MJML import/export, Scriban variable templating and live preview. Built entirely on Tempo.Blazor components.

items.description: State the property inspector remembers for the lifetime of one editor: the collapsible groups the user folded away (per block type) and the field edited last (the target of the caret-less variable insertion fallback).

members.name: AdvancedGroup
members.description: The group id of the collapsible "Advanced" section.

members.name: PaddingGroup
members.description: The group id of the collapsible "Spacing" section.

members.name: ClearFocus
members.description: Forgets the remembered field (e.g. when the inspected target changes).

members.name: IsGroupCollapsed
members.description: Whether the group is collapsed for the given owner (block type); groups start expanded.

members.name: SetGroupCollapsed
members.description: Stores the collapsed state of a group for one owner.

members.name: ToggleGroup
members.description: Flips the collapsed state of a group and returns the new state.

members.name: LastFocusedField
members.description: Gets or sets the field the user last put the caret into. A variable inserted while the caret-aware JS interop is unavailable lands behind this field's content, matching what the JS path would do.

items.description: The device the preview is rendered for: Desktop (the document content width), Tablet (768 px) and Mobile (390 px). The widths live in EmailPreviewMetrics so the component, its CSS and its tests cannot drift apart.

The ONE place the preview scene widths are defined: the tablet and mobile constants, the desktop stage margin, and the desktop width derived from the document's own ContentWidth. The component renders the number, its CSS frames it and the tests assert it — none of them repeats a magic number.

members.name: DefaultContentWidth
members.description: The content width used when ContentWidth is missing or unparsable.

members.name: DesktopMargin
members.description: The stage margin added around the desktop scene, in CSS pixels: the "paper" of the email sits on the secondary surface with a little breathing room on both sides.

members.name: MobileWidth
members.description: Mobile preview width in CSS pixels.

members.name: TabletWidth
members.description: Tablet preview width in CSS pixels.

members.name: ContentWidthOf
members.description: Parses ContentWidth (600px) into CSS pixels.

members.name: WidthFor
members.description: Returns the scene width in CSS pixels for device.

parameters.name: Document

parameters.name: OnClose

items.description: Modal dialog for importing an email template from MJML or JSON, via pasted text or a dropped file. Shows parse errors or a summary preview (section and warning counts) and confirms the import into the editor.

parameters.name: OnClose

parameters.name: OnImport
parameters.description: Raised with the imported document when the user confirms.

parameters.name: Show
parameters.description: Whether the dialog is shown.

items.description: Editor for a string-to-string dictionary, presenting each entry as an editable key/value pair with add and remove controls. Rebuilds the dictionary in place on every change.

parameters.name: Items
parameters.description: The dictionary being edited (rebuilt in place on every change).

parameters.name: OnChanged
parameters.description: Raised after the dictionary changes.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Renders the rows read-only: the inputs and the remove/add controls are disabled and every mutating method returns early, so an emulated edit cannot rewrite the dictionary.

items.description: Generic editor for an ordered list of model items. Each item is edited via TmEmailObjectFields, and the list supports adding, removing, and reordering (move up/down) entries.

parameters.name: ItemPrimary
parameters.description: Property names shown first for each item.

parameters.name: Items
parameters.description: The list of sub-elements being edited (mutated in place).

parameters.name: OnChanged
parameters.description: Raised after the list or any item changes.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Renders the list read-only: the native controls are disabled and every mutating method returns early, so a host that emulates a click (bUnit, a synthetic event) still cannot change the document.

items.description: Reflection-driven form that edits the scalar properties of a target model object. Named primary fields are shown first, with the remaining properties collapsed under an "Advanced" section, and any property can be excluded when handled elsewhere.

parameters.name: Exclude
parameters.description: Property names to omit (rendered by a dedicated editor elsewhere).

parameters.name: OnChanged
parameters.description: Raised after any field changes.

parameters.name: Placement
parameters.description: Restricts the fields to one inspector placement (the Content/Style tabs and the Spacing/Advanced groups). null renders every field of the target - the flat form a list-item editor uses.

parameters.name: Primary
parameters.description: Property names shown above the advanced group, in order (an ordering hint only).

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Renders every input disabled, so a read-only inspector shows the values but cannot edit them.

parameters.name: State
parameters.description: Shared inspector state (remembered group collapse state and the field the user edited last, which is where a variable token lands when caret interop is unavailable). A standalone instance keeps its own.

parameters.name: Target
parameters.description: The model object whose scalar properties are edited.

parameters.name: Variables
parameters.description: Host-provided variables offered next to every template-bearing field.

items.description: Context-sensitive property inspector for the currently selected section, column, or block. The header names the element and offers Duplicate/Delete as one-step undo actions; the body splits into an Obsah/Styl tab strip with the Spacing and Advanced fields in collapsible groups, and renders the element's common fields plus type-specific editors such as rich-text content, raw HTML, image upload, and variable insertion.

parameters.name: Document
parameters.description: The document being edited.

parameters.name: ImageUpload
parameters.description: Client-side limits applied to a picked image before OnImageUpload runs; null uses the ImageUploadOptions defaults (5 MB, images only).

parameters.name: OnChanged
parameters.description: Raised after any property changes.

parameters.name: OnDelete
parameters.description: Raised with the selected block id when the header's Delete action is used (rendered as a danger action). Without a handler the action is not rendered.

parameters.name: OnDuplicate
parameters.description: Raised with the selected block id when the header's Duplicate action is used. The editor implements it as one history step; without a handler the action is not rendered.

parameters.name: OnImageUpload
parameters.description: Optional host upload handler: receives a picked file and returns the hosted image URL.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Renders the inspector read-only: every control inside the panel is disabled natively and the upload affordance is hidden, so no property change can reach the document.

parameters.name: SelectedId
parameters.description: The selected node id (block, section or column); null edits the document settings.

parameters.name: Variables
parameters.description: Host-provided variables, merged with those extracted from the document.

items.description: Grid editor for a table block's cells. Lets the user edit each cell's text, mark rows as header rows, and add or remove rows and columns.

parameters.name: Block
parameters.description: The table block being edited (mutated in place).

parameters.name: OnChanged
parameters.description: Raised after the table changes.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Renders the grid read-only: the native controls are disabled and every mutating method returns early, so a host that emulates a cell edit (bUnit, a synthetic event) cannot change the document.

items.description: Central editing canvas that renders an email document's sections, columns, and blocks. Supports selection, drag-and-drop, keyboard navigation, and per-section toolbars for adding columns and moving, duplicating, or deleting a section.

parameters.name: Document
parameters.description: The document being displayed.

parameters.name: DragActive
parameters.description: Whether a drag is in progress (shows drop zones between blocks).

parameters.name: OnBlockDragStart
parameters.description: Raised when an existing block begins being dragged.

parameters.name: OnDocumentChanged
parameters.description: Raised after the document is mutated by a block/section/column action.

parameters.name: OnDropInColumn
parameters.description: Raised when a block is dropped into a column at an index.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: When true the canvas renders the document read-only: no inline block/section actions, no draggable blocks, no drop zones and no keyboard shortcut mutates the document (selection and navigation stay available so the inspector can still show what is selected).

parameters.name: SelectedId
parameters.description: The currently selected node id (block, column or section), if any.

parameters.name: SelectedIdChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the selection changes.

items.description: Top-level MJML email template editor. Renders the core TmEditorShell (Header / Toolbar / Left + LeftRail / Canvas / Right / StatusBar / MobileActions) and owns NO layout of its own: the shell decides desktop (>=1200), tablet (768-1199) and mobile (<768) from the editor's own container, keeps docked panels on desktop AND tablet (at most one expanded) and presents the palette/inspector as a non-modal bottom sheet (default) or a Bloky | Canvas | Vlastnosti tablist on a phone. The command row is a core TmToolbar with Overflow=Menu and a Priority per action (Save is Pinned); the mobile header holds the primary Save and the host's ToolbarStart while ToolbarEnd and the long-tail commands move into the „⋮“ overflow, and the action bar carries only Undo/Redo/Preview/Validate. The host reports every save outcome through OnSave and the editor owns the dirty state (IsDirty/IsDirtyChanged), IsSaving, ReadOnly and the single-flight save queue; SaveAsync() is public for a TmNavigationGuard.OnSaveAndLeave wiring. A failed or conflicting save is shown as an alert in the status bar, so the host's reason is readable without hovering the badge.

parameters.name: ActiveMobilePanel
parameters.description: The panel the mobile layout shows, two-way with ActiveMobilePanelChanged. The editor switches it to Right when the user selects a block (the inspector is where that selection is edited), and a host may drive it too.

parameters.name: ActiveMobilePanelChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the user picks another mobile tab, or when the editor follows a block selection.

parameters.name: AutoSave
parameters.description: Auto-save configuration; when enabled, edits are saved after a debounce interval.

parameters.name: Breakpoints
parameters.description: The two container widths that decide the layout. Null (default) uses new TmLayoutBreakpoints(768, 1200): below 768 the editor is a phone layout, from 1200 the full desktop chrome, in between the tablet layout.

parameters.name: Document
parameters.description: Gets or sets the edited document. Two-way bindable via DocumentChanged.

parameters.name: DocumentChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the document changes (for @bind-Document).

parameters.name: FooterActions
parameters.description: Optional host actions rendered at the end of the preview dialog footer — for example "Send test email". The editor never sends anything itself; the host owns that action and its result.

parameters.name: ImageUpload
parameters.description: Client-side limits (Accept, MaxBytes) applied to a picked image before OnImageUpload is called. null uses the defaults (5 MB, images only).

parameters.name: InitialMode
parameters.description: The layout rendered before the shell's first measurement. Defaults to Desktop, so a desktop host never sees a wrong compact frame.

parameters.name: IsDirtyChanged
parameters.description: Raised when IsDirty changes — only on a transition, never on initialization and never for an edit that keeps the document dirty.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: The layout the editor renders. Auto (default) lets the shell measure the editor's own container (never the viewport) and follow its width; a forced value renders that mode without a DOM, which is how a host or a test pins a tablet or phone layout. Forwarded to TmEditorShell unchanged.

parameters.name: MobilePanelPresentation
parameters.description: How the two panels present on a mobile layout. Sheet (default) keeps the canvas visible with a bottom sheet — a Blocks | Properties tab strip inside it while both panels are open; Tabs is a full-region Blocks | Canvas | Properties tablist with no sheet.

parameters.name: OnImageUpload
parameters.description: Optional host image-upload handler: receives a picked file, returns the hosted URL.

parameters.name: OnSave
parameters.description: Raised when the user requests a save.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Disables every editing path (toolbox, canvas drag&drop and inline actions, inspector inputs, import, undo/redo and the shortcuts that mutate the document) while keeping preview, validation and export available. SaveAsync returns a failed result without calling the host. The component never changes this value itself.

parameters.name: ResolvedLayoutChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the shell's resolved layout changes (the container crossed a breakpoint, or the host forced another LayoutMode). The initial value is not a change. Never bind this to LayoutMode — that would pin the layout and stop the shell from measuring.

parameters.name: ShowSaveButton
parameters.description: Whether the Save button is rendered. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: ShowSaveStatus
parameters.description: Whether the save-status badge is rendered. Defaults to true; the badge announces unsaved changes, the in-flight save, the relative time of the last confirmed save, a failure with the host's message and a conflict.

parameters.name: TimeProvider
parameters.description: Clock used for auto-save debouncing (overridable in tests).

parameters.name: ToolbarEnd
parameters.description: Optional host actions rendered at the end of the command bar, before the save chrome.

parameters.name: ToolbarStart
parameters.description: Optional host actions rendered at the start of the command bar (back, title, …).

parameters.name: ToolboxCollapsed
parameters.description: Whether the blocks palette is collapsed. Maps 1:1 onto TmEditorShell.CollapsedPanels (EditorShellPanel.Left), so the collapsed palette is the shell's rail with icons instead of a hidden list; the palette's own collapse arrow is off (ShowCollapseToggle=false). The editor mirrors the state it is given and reports every toggle — including a rail the shell imposes on a tablet — through ToolboxCollapsedChanged (D10).

parameters.name: ToolboxCollapsedChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the new state when the user collapses or expands the blocks palette. Bind it back into ToolboxCollapsed for a controlled palette; without a binding the palette toggles on its own (seeded from the parameter).

parameters.name: Variables
parameters.description: Host-provided variables offered by the variable picker (merged with extracted ones).

items.description: Live preview of the rendered email with desktop/mobile device toggles and HTML/plain-text view switching. Includes a sample-data editor (with generation) for resolving template variables and surfaces any rendering warnings.

parameters.name: CultureName
parameters.description: Culture the preview should be rendered in (for example cs-CZ); null keeps the renderer default (the document language, otherwise the invariant culture).

parameters.name: Document
parameters.description: The document to preview.

parameters.name: FooterActions
parameters.description: Optional host actions rendered at the end of the preview toolbar — for example "Send test email". The preview itself never sends anything.

parameters.name: InitialDevice
parameters.description: Device the preview starts in: Desktop (the document content width), Tablet (768 px) or Mobile (390 px). The user can switch afterwards. Defaults to Desktop.

parameters.name: ShowSampleDataEditor
parameters.description: When true (the default) the "Edit data" button opens the sample-data editor (TmCodeEditor with JSON validation). A send/preview-only page turns it off.

parameters.name: ShowViewToggle
parameters.description: When true (the default) the toolbar offers the HTML / plain-text switch. A send page that shows only the HTML turns it off.

parameters.name: TimeProvider
parameters.description: Clock used for the debounced re-render (overridable in tests).

parameters.name: VariablesJson
parameters.description: Optional variable data (JSON). When null, sample data is generated from the template.

parameters.name: VariablesJsonChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the edited sample data so the host can persist it (for example in the template SampleDataJson).

items.description: Palette of email building blocks from the block registry, grouped by category, plus a set of column-layout presets. A search field filters the tiles by their localized name (diacritics- and case-insensitive) with a localized empty state, tiles show the icon above a wrapping label whose full name is in title, and a collapse toggle folds the palette to its rail. Clicking or dragging a block raises the add/drag callbacks, and choosing a preset inserts a new section.

parameters.name: Collapsed
parameters.description: Whether the palette is collapsed to its rail. Collapsing hides the search field and the tile groups (the toggle stays, so the panel is never a dead end); the editor maps this to the left panel width and F8 maps it to TmEditorShell.CollapsedPanels (D10).

parameters.name: CollapsedChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the new collapsed state when the palette's toggle is used.

parameters.name: OnAddBlock
parameters.description: Raised when a block is chosen (clicked) to be added.

parameters.name: OnAddSection
parameters.description: Raised when a layout preset is chosen to add as a new section.

parameters.name: OnDragBlockStart
parameters.description: Raised when a block drag starts (for drag-and-drop onto the canvas).

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: When true the tiles stay visible but inert: not draggable, aria-disabled, and neither a click nor a keyboard activation raises OnAddBlock/OnAddSection.

parameters.name: ShowCollapseToggle
parameters.description: Whether the palette renders its own collapse arrow. Defaults to true; a host that owns the shell chrome sets it to false so the same state has one control instead of two (Faze 8 maps ToolboxCollapsed onto TmEditorShell.CollapsedPanels, whose panel toggle is then the only arrow).

items.description: Lists validation findings for the email document, combining structural checks with Scriban template-syntax validation of every template-bearing string. Each finding is severity-tagged and, when clicked, navigates to the offending node.

parameters.name: Document
parameters.description: The document to validate.

parameters.name: OnNavigate
parameters.description: Raised with the offending node id when a finding is clicked.

items.description: Searchable list of the template variables available to the document. Selecting a variable raises OnInsert with its {{ path }} token, and collection variables are badged so array bindings are recognizable.

parameters.name: OnInsert
parameters.description: Raised with the {{ path }} token when a variable is chosen.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Renders the picker read-only: inserting a variable edits the document, so the list is disabled and OnInsert is never called.

parameters.name: Variables
parameters.description: The variables available to insert (extracted from the document plus host-provided).

items.description: Configures the editor's debounced auto-save behaviour.

members.name: Enabled
members.description: Gets or sets whether auto-save is enabled.

members.name: Interval
members.description: Gets or sets the debounce interval after the last change before auto-saving.

items.description: Options of the editor-only registration (AddTempoEmailTemplateEditor): the sandbox limits shared with validation and variable extraction. They are the limits of the one TemplateSecurityOptions instance the model registration owns, so the editor and a local render always agree; the function namespaces of the registered ITemplateFunctionProviders are added automatically.

members.name: Security
members.description: Gets the sandbox limits shared with validation and variable extraction.

items.description: Marker type identifying the Tempo.Blazor.EmailTemplates UI assembly. Used as the assembly anchor for localization resource resolution and component discovery.

members.name: Assembly
members.description: Gets the assembly that contains the email template editor components.

items.description: Client-side validation the editor applies to a picked image before it hands the file to OnImageUpload, so a host never pays for an upload it would reject. A rejected file leaves the block's Src untouched and shows a localized error in the property panel.

members.name: Accept
members.description: Gets or sets the accepted MIME types, comma separated, with optional * wildcards (the accept attribute syntax). Defaults to image/*.

members.name: MaxBytes
members.description: Gets or sets the largest accepted file size in bytes. Defaults to 5 MB — the same bound the template import uses.

items.description: AddTempoEmailTemplateEditor — UI plus the model side, and NOT the local render engine. The host supplies IEmailPreviewRenderer (typically a server endpoint) and optionally ITemplateValidator; for a local render add the Tempo.Blazor.EmailTemplates.Engine package and call AddTempoEmailTemplateEngine. AddTempoEmailTemplates is the [Obsolete] pre-2.10 shortcut and delegates here without registering an engine.
Localization accessor for the email template editor UI. Backed by IStringLocalizer<TmEmailResources>; hosts may replace it to fully control strings.
Marker class for the Tempo.Blazor.EmailTemplates UI string resources. Used with IStringLocalizer<TmEmailResources> and the accompanying .resx files (English default, Czech and French).
In-memory, block-level clipboard for the editor. Copy stores an independent snapshot; paste returns a fresh copy with new identifiers each time, so repeated pastes never collide.

members.name: Clear
members.description: Clears the clipboard.

members.name: Copy
members.description: Stores an independent copy of the block on the clipboard.

members.name: Paste
members.description: Returns a fresh copy (with new ids) of the clipboard block, or null if empty.

members.name: CanPaste
members.description: Gets whether a block is available to paste.

items.description: Maintains undo/redo history of document snapshots. Each pushed state is a deep, independent copy, the depth is bounded, and rapid edits sharing a coalesce key within a short window merge into a single undo step (so typing is one undo, not one per keystroke).

members.name: Initialize
members.description: Resets the history to a single baseline state.

members.name: Push
members.description: Records a new document state. When coalesceKey matches the previous push and falls within the coalesce window, it replaces the current state instead of adding a new step.

members.name: Redo
members.description: Moves one step forward and returns an independent copy of that state, or null.

members.name: Undo
members.description: Moves one step back and returns an independent copy of that state, or null.

members.name: CanRedo
members.description: Gets whether a redo is available.

members.name: CanUndo
members.description: Gets whether an undo is available.
